expectations.text: States the Cyberbeveiligingswet (Cbw) entered into force August 15, 2026, transposing NIS2 and replacing the Wbni
expectations.evidence: on 15 August 2026 the Cyberbeveiligingswet (Cbw) entered into force... replacing the previous Wet beveiliging netwerk- en informatiesystemen (Wbni)

expectations.text: Gives the scale: over 8,000 organisations across 18 sectors in scope
expectations.evidence: Roughly 8,000 organisations across 18 sectors fall in scope

expectations.text: States the registration duty: register in the entity register via NCSC (MijnNCSC) — mandatory as of entry into force
expectations.evidence: In-scope entities must register with the national authority via MijnNCSC... this is the most urgent action item

expectations.text: States there is no transition/grace period: duty of care (risk-management measures) and incident reporting apply immediately
expectations.evidence: it applies immediately — there is no transition period... 'Duty of care (zorgplicht) applies now'... 'Incident reporting obligations apply now'

expectations.text: Mentions board-level accountability: management ultimately responsible, with knowledge/training obligations
expectations.evidence: your management body must approve the risk-management measures... and undergo cybersecurity training itself... Management can face personal liability
